Container.Name: Blizzbeat
Container.Overview: Blizzbeat is a Discord music bot with Lavalink built in. It gets its own channel with an animated banner and one live player (now playing, progress, queue, buttons) that is edited in place. People type a song name or link, or drop an audio file, to play it. Slash commands cover admin settings (/config) and playback (/play, /queue, /favourites ...).[br][br]Plays YouTube (Lavalink plugin or yt-dlp), SoundCloud, Spotify (matched on YouTube), Bandcamp, Twitch, uploaded files and anything yt-dlp supports. Lavalink and its plugins update themselves on launch and daily.[br][br]Only the Discord bot token is required. Create the bot at https://discord.com/developers/applications, turn on the Message Content intent, then invite it with the link printed in the container log.
Container.Requires: A Discord bot token (Developer Portal: Bot, Reset Token) with the Message Content intent turned on.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Bot token from https://discord.com/developers/applications (Bot, Reset Token).

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Settings database, favourites, YouTube sign-in, custom banners, auto-updates and uploaded-file copies.

Config.Name: Lavalink plugins
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Cache for Lavalink plugins (YouTube, LavaSrc) so they aren't downloaded on every start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: REQUIRED. User the bot runs as (owns the app data). Unraid: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Group the bot runs as. Unraid: 100 (users).

Config.Name: Type-to-queue (Message Content)
Config.Description: Optional. Typing songs and dropping files in the Blizzbeat channel. Needs the Message Content intent turned on in the Developer Portal; false = /play only.

Config.Name: Spotify client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on Spotify links and search (songs play from YouTube). Create an app at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard.

Config.Name: Spotify client secret
Config.Description: Optional. Secret of the same Spotify app.

Config.Name: Spotify country
Config.Description: Optional. Country for Spotify search results (two letters, e.g. AU, US).

Config.Name: YouTube backend
Config.Description: Optional. How YouTube is played: plugin (Lavalink's YouTube plugin, seekable) or ytdlp. /config youtube in Discord overrides this.

Config.Name: Auto-update
Config.Description: Optional. On launch and daily, move to newer Lavalink, YouTube plugin, LavaSrc and yt-dlp releases (rolled back if they fail).

Config.Name: Animated banner
Config.Description: Optional. Use the animated default banner in the Blizzbeat channel; false = still image.

Config.Name: Default volume
Config.Description: Optional. Starting volume in %. 100 keeps original audio quality.

Config.Name: Max volume
Config.Description: Optional. Highest volume people can set, in %.

Config.Name: Queue limit
Config.Description: Optional. Most songs in a queue.

Config.Name: Auto-leave (minutes)
Config.Description: Optional. Leave voice after this many minutes of nothing playing or nobody listening.

Config.Name: Search source
Config.Description: Optional. Where song names are searched: ytmsearch (YouTube Music), ytsearch (YouTube), scsearch (SoundCloud), spsearch (Spotify).

Config.Name: Embed colour
Config.Description: Optional. Player colour as a hex code without #.

Config.Name: Request cooldown (s)
Config.Description: Optional. Seconds between song requests per person (0 = off). Admins are never limited.

Config.Name: Control cooldown (s)
Config.Description: Optional. Seconds between button presses per person (0 = off).

Config.Name: Dev server ID
Config.Description: Optional. Register slash commands to this one server instantly (for testing). Empty = all servers.

Config.Name: Progress refresh (s)
Config.Description: Optional. How often the progress bar on the player refreshes (5-120).

Config.Name: Resume queues up to (minutes)
Config.Description: Optional. After a restart, resume queues saved at most this long ago (0 = no limit). 24/7 servers always resume.

Config.Name: Audio buffer (ms)
Config.Description: Optional. Decoded audio Lavalink keeps ready (200-30000). /config buffer in Discord overrides this.

Config.Name: yt-dlp Opus bitrate
Config.Description: Optional. Bitrate for yt-dlp songs whose audio isn't Opus already (Opus is passed through untouched).

Config.Name: Java options
Config.Description: Optional. Memory for the built-in Lavalink.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Optional. How much the bot writes to the container log.

Config.Name: Lavalink password
Config.Description: Optional. Lavalink is only reachable inside the container; a random password is generated when empty.

Config.Name: YouTube plugin version
Config.Description: Optional. Pin a youtube-source release (e.g. 1.19.0) or 40-character commit. Empty = tested default plus auto-updates.

Config.Name: LavaSrc version
Config.Description: Optional. Pin a LavaSrc release (Spotify support). Empty = default plus auto-updates.

Config.Name: YouTube clients
Config.Description: Optional. YouTube plugin clients, tried in order. TV is always included (it uses the signed-in account).

Config.Name: Built-in cipher (yt-cipher)
Config.Description: Optional. Run yt-cipher inside the container to decode YouTube stream signatures.

Config.Name: yt-cipher player variant
Config.Description: Optional. YouTube player variant yt-cipher decodes against.

Config.Name: yt-cipher threads
Config.Description: Optional. Worker threads for yt-cipher.

Config.Name: Remote cipher URL
Config.Description: Optional. Use your own cipher server instead of the built-in one.

Config.Name: Remote cipher password
Config.Description: Optional. Password for the remote cipher server.

Config.Name: YouTube OAuth refresh token
Config.Description: Optional. Sign the YouTube plugin in with an existing refresh token. Easier: /config youtube login in Discord.

Config.Name: YouTube OAuth log sign-in
Config.Description: Optional. true without a refresh token makes the plugin print its own sign-in code in the log.

Config.Name: YouTube PO token
Config.Description: Optional. poToken for the plugin's WEB client (needs visitor data too).

Config.Name: YouTube visitor data
Config.Description: Optional. visitorData that goes with the PO token.
